title: Copper Reinforcements
description: This mod makes copper useful by being able to do slight upgrades to diamond tools using it
body:
This mod makes copper useful by being able to do slight upgrades to diamond tools using it.
## What improvements does it give
1. Reinforcing a diamond tool won't give any damage or speed buffs, however, it will give other improvements.
1. 📕Enchantability: The reinforced tools have 20 enchantability
1. 🔨Durability: The reinforced tools have increased durability
1. 🔥The reinforced tools are inmune to fire
## How does it work?
You can use a smithing table and place any diamond tool, a copper ingot and a block of copper to get the reinforced version of that tool. This process will remove any enchants on the tool![How to make it](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2dd21e3f9e33d1e10c4096f8333dfa2947d5d947.png)
